content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

For dog dirt left on the pavement dog owners should by all means pay a bit more. Indeed it's not the fault of the animals, but once you step in it, their excrement seems to stick rather persistently to your soles.
What is the relation between "but once you step in it, their excrement seems to stick rather persistently to your soles." and "Indeed it's not the fault of the animals," from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
